architecture_note: conflicts with NEXA news veto / FOMC gate: coexistence needs a human design

costs.swap: contracts.json swap_long/short on positions crossing server 00:00

execution.limit_fill: trade-through by through_points (touch is not a fill)

hypothesis: H1b: after the initial spike, the sign of the post-release return follows the sign of the standardised surprise more often than chance, net of costs
leakage_rules: a decision at closed entry bar t uses only bars with open time <= t (start_pos=1 semantics)
a higher-timeframe bar is visible only if open + len(tf) <= decision_ts + len(entry_tf)
all rolling statistics are trailing; no full-sample normalisation, centring, z-scoring or quantiles
thresholds/quantiles are fitted only on the training span: DEV for VAL; years < Y for WF year Y
labels may use data after entry but never enter any feature
every feature/signal builder must pass nexa_causality.certify and be registered BEFORE opening
the EXCLUDED window and the OOS window are never read before the OOS result is recorded

event eligibility = nexa_calendar.f1_eligible: HIGH, MT5 type INDICATOR, exact DATETIME, first_print == CONFIRMED (REVISED_VALUE / UNDETERMINED excluded), forecast present, >= 12 prior releases, local clock == PRIOR-ONLY modal clock, prior-only surprise sd > 0
surprise = (actual - forecast) / prior_surprise_sd from STRICTLY EARLIER confirmed releases
no statistic of an event uses that event's own or any later release
H1a (volatility elevation) is descriptive only: not a claim, not recorded, not promotable
OOS: first prints must be captured live at release (calendar logger); historical next-release confirmation is not available for the latest release

periods_utc.semantics: half-open [start, end) in UTC; OOS is prospective (post-freeze); EXCLUDED may not be read for selection, validation, promotion or reporting of any V2 claim

purge_embargo.rule: a trade belongs to a period only if entry >= start + embargo (except DEV start) and exit/label end < end; trades straddling a boundary are PURGED

robustness.note: robustness runs apply ONLY to the sealed trial and can never change the selection

tests.bootstrap: stationary block (block = max hold), 5000 draws, seed 20260928
tests.null_rule: intersection-union: every declared null p <= alpha
tests.selection_rule: per (experiment, claim, symbol): highest lower-95% bootstrap bound of VAL E[R] among trials with >= min_trades_report VAL trades; ties -> fewer parameters then lexicographic trial_id; sealed via OOS_SELECTED before OOS start

timezone.bar_clock: PEPPERSTONE_NY_CLOSE (server = New York local + 7 h; US DST)
timezone.calendar_conversion: research/nexa_calendar.py FIXED_EXPORT_OFFSET from export provenance, never the bar clock
timezone.session_windows: defined in UTC and converted per bar; never fixed server hours
